subject: 沈阳清昭陵 · 隆恩殿正面（含须弥座台基与月台三出陛）
name: 沈阳清昭陵
sub: 隆恩殿 · 三间周围廊歇山殿
yearNote: 昭陵崇德八年（1643）始建，顺治八年（1651）陵制初备，此后康熙、乾隆、嘉庆等朝多次增建改建（辽宁文旅）。现存隆恩殿的具体营建或改建年份未查到，年表取1643年始建作约略定位，图版绘殿现状正面。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q8189796（清昭陵 Zhao Mausoleum）P625 坐标 41.85038, 123.4213，陵区近似坐标、非隆恩殿实测；地图显示点复用既有 shenyang。
lede: 皇太极与孝端文皇后的陵寝，崇德八年（1643）动工，顺治八年（1651）陵制初备，康熙、乾隆各朝又有增建，2004年随明清皇家陵寝列入世界遗产。方城正中的隆恩殿是祭享正殿：三间殿身四面绕廊，单檐歇山覆黄琉璃瓦，坐在带汉白玉栏杆的须弥座上，月台前并列三道石阶。
facts: 年代：清崇德八年（1643）始建，顺治八年（1651）陵制初备，此后康熙、乾隆、嘉庆等朝多次增建改建；1982年列第二批国保，2004年列入世界遗产。
形制：隆恩殿面阔三间、周围廊，单檐歇山顶、黄琉璃瓦；殿立于带汉白玉望柱栏杆的须弥座台基上，前出月台，月台正面三出陛、两端各一陛，踏跺旁置螭首。
图版：取2024年正对殿前的实拍，保留廊柱、三间槛窗槛门、台基栏杆与三道台阶；殿前围栏与游人去除，远处方城角楼与明楼不入图。
caption: 清昭陵 · 隆恩殿正面
清 · 1643–1651
structure_checkpoints: 屋顶：单檐歇山，正脊两端大吻，垂脊与戗脊各有脊兽；檐口平直、角部起翘，檐下一圈斗栱与彩画额枋。
廊柱：正面可数六根红色圆柱（灰度“红度”剖面检出6根，间距约90/165/175/175/90）——最外两根为周围廊角柱，其内两根为殿身角柱（透过廊可见），中间两根夹明间；殿身三间等宽。
门窗：明间为格扇门，门前一道低矮红木栅栏（现代，去除）；次间为菱花槛窗，下为槛墙；门窗在廊柱之后一进处。
台基：须弥座台基，上缘一圈汉白玉望柱与栏板；正面中部突出月台，月台前沿并列三道踏跺（中为御路），月台左右两端各一道侧阶；踏跺下端立石螭首。
周边：殿后方城墙体与远处角楼、明楼在照片中可见，图版不画；两侧松树去除。
material_observations: 屋面黄色琉璃筒瓦，檐口剪边略带绿色；斗栱与额枋青绿彩画加金线；柱身朱红；槛窗槛门朱红带金色菱花；台基与栏杆灰白色汉白玉与青石；月台地面青灰石板。
author: ScareCriterion12

source_note: 主图与补充图均为 ScareCriterion12 2024 年 10 月实拍（CC0）；原图分别为 24.0 MB 与 24.5 MB，按规则保留上一轮下载的 Commons 2048px 缩略图（经 SHA1 无法直接匹配、按宽高比 7790×5217→2048×1372、7736×5217→2048×1381 与内容核对为同一文件）。隆恩殿开间与周围廊按主图红柱计数确定，文献未给出开间数。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Long'en Hall (隆恩殿, sacrificial hall) of the Zhaoling Mausoleum of Hong Taiji in Shenyang, drawn straight on from Image 2 (2024 frontal photo); Image 3 is a closer wide-angle view of the same facade for detail only. A single-eave hip-and-gable hall of THREE bays surrounded by an open gallery: the front shows SIX red round columns – one gallery corner column at each end, then (slightly behind) the hall's own corner column, then two columns flanking the central bay. Central bay: lattice doors; side bays: lattice windows over a low wall. Yellow glazed tube-tile roof (draw as sparse tile strokes), large ridge-end ornaments, ridge beasts, a row of bracket-sets under the eave. The hall stands on a Sumeru-profile stone terrace with a white marble balustrade of posts and panels; in front projects a terrace (moon platform) with THREE parallel stair flights on its front edge (the central one with a carved ramp) and one flight at each end, small dragon-head spouts at the stair feet. Remove the low modern wooden railing in front of the door, the sign board, people, the pine trees and the distant walls, corner towers and tower behind. Landscape 1536×1024, hall plus full terrace about 82% of width.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
